description: This Java class, DigitalProductDaoImpl, is a data access object implementation that handles database operations related to DigitalProduct entities. It provides methods to retrieve DigitalProduct instances by associated Product and MerchantStore, leveraging QueryDSL for building type-safe JPQL queries.

classes.name: DigitalProductDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DigitalProductDao for accessing DigitalProduct entities from the database.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct associated with a given Product and MerchantStore, returning null if not found, or throwing an exception if multiple results are found.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct by its unique identifier.
